item.title: reality is patient
item.description:
临溪流以静对，访草木以素心，登高极目知天地之大，置己苍茫知寸身之微。

当欲望得不到满足便痛苦，当欲望得到满足便无聊，人生就像钟摆一样在痛苦与无聊之间摆荡。– 叔本华

investing

The rate hike by Fed may end the rally of stock market. If so, the first time of hiking rate in three years? If no hike, yields continue to spike. The trend is your friend, always. Even there is a hike, the long-term yields will spike because physical supply is not that easy to reverse due to the Iran war. Bitcoin down, gold up, oil prices slides but still over $100.
